meta.name: understand-dashboard
meta.description: Launch the interactive web dashboard to visualize a codebase's knowledge graph

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 可视化代码库知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要直观浏览代码库的结构和依赖关系。
copy.tagline_en: Visualize your codebase's knowledge graph interactively.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explore your codebase's structure and dependencies visually.

howto.what: 启动一个本地网页仪表盘,把项目的知识图谱可视化。它会先检查项目里有没有 knowledge-graph.json,缺依赖就安装并构建,然后在后台跑起 Vite 服务器,并把带 token 的访问网址发给你。
howto.when: 当你运行 /understand-dashboard 时触发;可以附带项目路径,不带就用当前工作目录。如果项目里没有知识图谱,它会提示你先运行 /understand 分析项目。

say.text: 打开仪表盘,看看这个项目的知识图谱
say.note: 在后台启动服务器并给出访问网址

say.text: 提示没有知识图谱,那先对这个项目跑 /understand
say.note: 先生成图谱文件再启动仪表盘

howto.what_en: Starts a local web dashboard that visualizes your project's knowledge graph. It checks for knowledge-graph.json, installs dependencies, builds, runs a Vite server in the background, then gives you the tokenized URL.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /understand-dashboard, optionally with a project path; otherwise it uses the current working directory. If no knowledge graph exists, it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Open the dashboard for this project's knowledge graph
say_en.note: Starts the server in the background
Treats that path as the project directory

say_en.text: It says no knowledge graph — run /understand on this project
